title: Crypto rebounds after Fed hike; tax bill advances and portfolio reaches $126,200
paragraphs: Bitcoin rose 0.9% over 24 hours to about $76,600, while Ether gained 1.1% to roughly $2,444 in CoinDesk�s market report. The recovery extended well beyond the two largest coins: 94 of its 100 index constituents were higher, and smaller tokens outpaced the largest assets. Equity futures also advanced. US spot Bitcoin ETFs nevertheless recorded another roughly $296 million of net outflows, showing that the price rebound has yet to coincide with renewed demand through those funds.

The Federal Reserve raised its policy rate by a quarter point to 3.75%�4.00%, with all 12 voters supporting the decision. Its statement described solid economic activity and persistently elevated inflation. CoinDesk reported that policymakers� median projections implied only one further quarter-point increase through the end of next year. That limited projected tightening helped frame the market response, although the forecasts are conditional and the rally cannot be attributed to one announcement alone. Higher rates continue to make cash and short-term government debt more competitive with risky assets.

In Washington, the House Ways and Means Committee approved the Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act by 38 votes to five and sent it to the full House. The proposal addresses small transactions, income recognition, staking, mining and broker requirements. Clearer treatment could reduce the accounting friction of using crypto for ordinary payments. This is a committee advance, with further legislative steps still required before any provisions become law. The bipartisan vote gives crypto tax legislation some momentum following the separate market-structure bill�s Senate setback.

Payward, Kraken�s parent company, announced plans to offer US clients onchain perpetual futures through Hyperliquid. Bitnomial would create and administer the markets and clear the contracts, while NinjaTrader Clearing would carry approved customer accounts. Regulatory approval remains a condition. The proposal could connect a public blockchain order book with regulated US derivatives infrastructure and expand access to onchain products. It does not open Hyperliquid�s existing markets to all US users, and Payward has not announced a launch date.

Our portfolio is worth about $126,200, split between $12,100 in the active treasury and $114,100 in the cold Safe. Comparable wallet totals increased by about $1,900, or 1.53%. The Safe�s 26.74 million ARC are worth $96,300, about 76% of the entire portfolio before pool exposure. That balance is unchanged, with its valuation up around $1,570. Both Aerodrome pools hold WETH and ARC and together are worth $15,250, adding further ARC exposure. Concentration remains our largest portfolio risk.

Treasury cbETH accounts for about $4,390 and the three stock tokens for $1,530. Visible lending debt totals about $3,926 in USDC against approximately $9,526 of supplied assets across Aave and Fluid. Aave health factors are 3.01 in the treasury, slightly higher, and an unchanged 2.01 in the Safe. Fluid�s roughly $200 net position still has a narrow liquidation buffer at a 1.08 health factor.
